explication: ntfy is an HTTP publish-subscribe notification service. Publishers send a message to a topic; the server authenticates and authorizes the request, dispatches it to topic subscribers, persists it for polling/replay, and triggers optional delivery side effects. Web and mobile-oriented clients subscribe, store notifications locally, and display them. The sampled source confirms server routing, topic subscription, user ACLs, persistence, attachments, web push, payments, and maintenance; several integrations are represented at their enclosing paths because their internals were not sampled.
